title: Plasticity of human microglia and brain perivascular macrophages in aging and Alzheimer's disease.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Synapse REST API (Synapse is Sage Bionetworks' data-sharing platform) for project syn52795287: entity metadata, the wiki listing 18 supplementary tables and 2 processed single-cell files (DataS1_FreshMG_final.h5ad syn52795302, DataS2_PsychAD_final.h5ad syn52795303, TableS4_metadata_PsychAD.csv syn52795314, TableS11 pseudotime CSV). Access-requirement endpoint returns 0 requirements and restrictionLevel OPEN, but every download attempt returns 403 'Anonymous users have only READ access permission'; file sizes are also hidden from anonymous users. GitHub code repo DiseaseNeuroGenomics/scMyeloidAD README read (MIT licence, analysis code only, no data).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: 832,505 myeloid cells, 1,607 donors, 13 subtypes in 6 subclasses, AD (Alzheimer's disease) pathology phenotypes and age per donor: all from the abstract and the Synapse wiki text. Full text not open (no PMCID; nature.com and medRxiv both blocked fetching). No row counts, column names or file sizes verified.

a1_downloadable.note: Checked via Synapse API: files are marked OPEN with no data-use agreement, but download requires logging in to a (free, certified) Synapse account; anonymous requests get HTTP 403. Login requirement = A1 fail by our rule. Underlying raw PsychAD data is separately controlled-access through the AD Knowledge Portal.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not verified. Per the wiki, TableS4_metadata_PsychAD.csv holds donor clinical metadata (presumably age, AD diagnosis, Braak/CERAD pathology scores) that would serve as donor-level labels; columns unseen.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not verified. Processed h5ad (annotated single-cell expression matrix) files are listed; contents unseen.

a4_units_stated.note: Not verified; pathology stages are ordinal scales without units, expression is counts.

a5_enough_rows.note: Not verified. The modelling unit for any donor-level label is the donor: 1,607 per the abstract, just above the ~1,500 bar and only if most have labels; cell count (832,505) is not the independent unit.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; h5ad sizes hidden from anonymous users
a6_fits_laptop.note: 832k cells × ~30k genes sparse would likely be a few GB; donor pseudobulk would be small. Not verified.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not check: no file opened.

a8_label_provenance.note: Not verified. Neuropathology scores (Braak, CERAD) are physical post-mortem measurements, not model outputs; subtype labels and pseudotime would be computed from the expression features and must not be used as targets.

existing_models.name: Cell-type-resolved pseudobulk classifier (bioRxiv 2026, microglial PTPRG paper)
existing_models.score_and_split: Logistic regression on 228 variable genes from ROSMAP single-nucleus pseudobulk; balanced accuracy 0.87, AUC 0.89 on held-out ROSMAP samples, reported to generalise to independent cohorts (from search snippet only).

existing_models.name: Trivedi et al. 2026 MLP on ROSMAP microglia
existing_models.score_and_split: Multi-layer perceptron classifying AD vs control nuclei; score and split not retrieved (cell-level classification risks donor leakage).

backbone.name: scGPT or Geneformer (single-cell foundation models)
backbone.hardware: CPU embedding of 832k cells would take many hours; subsample per donor

integration.partner_dataset: ROSMAP / SEA-AD single-nucleus atlases (AD Knowledge Portal, controlled or login-gated)
integration.join_key: gene symbol / Ensembl gene; donor-level pathology scales
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Does a donor's microglial state mix predict AD pathology in an independent brain bank?

controls.positive_control: GPNMB-subtype fraction rising with Braak stage (paper's headline result).
controls.external_validation: FreshMG cohort in the same Synapse project, or ROSMAP/SEA-AD.

honest_claim_h3: Predicts post-mortem AD pathology stage from the prefrontal-cortex myeloid-cell composition of donors in Mount Sinai/Rush brain banks.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use each donor's brain immune-cell gene activity to predict how much Alzheimer's damage their brain shows at autopsy.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-donor summaries of gene activity and cell-type proportions of microglia and brain macrophages; 1,607 donors per the abstract (unverified).
plain_idea.predict: Post-mortem neuropathology scores (plaque and tangle stage) and age, recorded by brain-bank pathologists per donor.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would test whether the immune-cell state alone carries enough signal to stage disease, and whether that transfers to other brain banks.

more_or_better_data.why: 1,607 donors (paper) is larger than typical ROSMAP microglia sets (~400–450 donors), but unverified and myeloid-only.

confidence_score.why: No replicate brains per donor; nothing checked supports calibrated uncertainty.

models_beatable.why: The 2026 pseudobulk logistic regression already reports AUC 0.89 on held-out ROSMAP; a simple baseline that is hard to beat by much.

guaranteed_improvement.why: Existing models' code/weights not confirmed runnable and cohorts differ, so same-split comparison is not possible.

label_elsewhere.sources: ROSMAP and SEA-AD record the same Braak/CERAD pathology scores per donor (known resources), but behind the AD Knowledge Portal login or data-use agreements.
label_elsewhere.join_key: Not joinable item-wise; donors are different people, shared only at gene and phenotype level
label_elsewhere.why: Other cohorts allow external validation of a donor-level model but not more training rows for the same donors.

ml_idea: Donor-level pseudobulk (and subtype-proportion) model predicting Braak/CERAD stage and age from myeloid cells, trained on PsychAD and tested on FreshMG or ROSMAP. Blocked at download: needs a Synapse login.

effort.compute_note: Not estimable: file sizes are hidden from anonymous Synapse users and nothing was downloaded.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: With a free Synapse account, download TableS4_metadata_PsychAD.csv and count donors with non-missing Braak and CERAD scores; under ~1,000 kills the donor-level regression.

verdict_reason: A1 fails: the processed files are flagged OPEN with no data-use agreement, but Synapse refuses anonymous downloads (HTTP 403) and requires a free certified account, so nothing could be opened or counted. If the user registers a Synapse account, this is worth re-evaluating, since a donor-level metadata CSV plus myeloid h5ad from about 1,607 donors is listed; the existing 2026 pseudobulk AD classifiers (AUC 0.89) mean the field is moderately crowded.
